question: ¿Qué cinco concesiones concentran más anomalías térmicas detectadas por satélite desde el 1/1/2024, ubicando cada punto dentro de su contorno?

attempts.query:
with poli as (
  select c.id_concesion, c.areapermisoconcesion,
         ('(' || string_agg('(' || (p.v->>0) || ',' || (p.v->>1) || ')', ',' order by p.ord) || ')')::polygon as pg
  from sig_energia.concesion c
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(c.anillo::jsonb) with ordinality as p(v, ord)
  where c.anillo is not null and jsonb_typeof(c.anillo::jsonb) = 'array'
  group by c.id_concesion, c.areapermisoconcesion
  having count(*) >= 3
)
select pl.areapermisoconcesion
from poli pl
join sig_energia.venteo_detectado d
  on d.fecha >= date '2024-01-01'
 and pl.pg @> point(d.lon, d.lat)
group by pl.id_concesion, pl.areapermisoconcesion
order by count(*) desc
limit 5
